entries.dialogueText: Everyone turned toward the noise, their faces drained of color.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Betrayal has its consequences.""
entries.dialogueText: "Betrayal has its consequences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: I grabbed my glass and held it up high.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was subtle, but it was enough."
entries.dialogueText: It was subtle, but it was enough.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To my mother, Queen Estela, and to..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Well, it was worth a try."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How unfortunate. For you.""
entries.dialogueText: "How unfortunate. For you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And that’s when it began."
entries.dialogueText: And that’s when it began.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I watched in silence."
entries.dialogueText: I watched in silence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I gave you a peaceful way out of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave you a peaceful way out of this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a brief pause, followed b..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a brief pause, followed by a subtle exchange of glances.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a rustling of formalwear, the..."
entries.dialogueText: With a rustling of formalwear, the other Torases and the heads of House Sazon and House Azaro got up and followed me into the trophy room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hate to spoil the fun, but it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate to spoil the fun, but it's time I had a talk with my fellow royal houses. Please come to the trophy room."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's one renovation that hasn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's one renovation that hasn't been unveiled yet -- the new trophy room. Would the leaders of each house be so kind as to follow me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ladies and gentlemen, heads of eac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen, heads of each House, I ask that you join me in private for a brief discussion."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough with the pleasantries. I ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough with the pleasantries. I need the leaders of each house to come with me. Now."

entries.dialogueText: "Is something wrong, Father?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing to concern yourself over,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing to concern yourself over, dear. I need you to stay here and entertain your grandmother."

entries.dialogueText: "It seems I'm not invited either, then."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enjoy your birthday, Mother.""
entries.dialogueText: "Enjoy your birthday, Mother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I’ll update you later when the time is right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You’re not missing anything you'd want to see, believe me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "If you say so, but that sounds rather ominous."

entries.dialogueText: "How convenient. Well, somebody's got to keep the lesser nobles entertained during your secret chat."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'd enjoy it a lot more if I knew..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd enjoy it a lot more if I knew what mischief my son was planning."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I kissed Mother on the cheek before..."
entries.dialogueText: I kissed Mother on the cheek before stepping away.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""What are you up to, Romus?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you up to, Romus?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just getting the festiburu hung up..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just getting the festiburu hung up. You'll have the first swing after Grandmother, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She tilted her head in annoyance."
entries.dialogueText: She tilted her head in annoyance.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I see. So I'm not invited, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see. So I'm not invited, then."

entries.title: Vina Toras: ""So I'm not invited. Got it.""
entries.dialogueText: "So I'm not invited. Got it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’m simply handling something that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I’m simply handling something that requires my immediate attention, that's all."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""How conveniently cryptic.""
entries.dialogueText: "How conveniently cryptic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing to concern yourself over,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing to concern yourself over, Mother. We'll be back out before you know it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
